card.line: Smyrna was a city in Asia Minor, about 40 miles north of Ephesus, and it was home to one of the seven churches Jesus wrote to in Revelation.

moments.title: Named among the seven churches
moments.text: John hears a loud voice tell him to write what he sees and send it to seven churches. Smyrna is one of them.

moments.title: A message to the church in Smyrna
moments.text: The First and the Last, who died and returned to life, knows the church's suffering and poverty. He tells them not to fear, to be faithful even to death, and promises them the crown of life.
